criteria: From /workspace/tcg-vendor-calendar/data/events.json: date_status=confirmed, start_date year >= 2027, exact YYYY-MM-DD start and end dates.
method: Official-site research only. Emails and prices are included only when published on official organiser pages (or official PDFs) and verified in this research. Third-party or unverified figures are omitted. No outreach was sent.
